result.instruction: In `spi_master_core`, remove `rsp_data_reg` and drive `rsp_data` from `rx_shift`; remove its reset and completion assignments. Preserve the receive shift schedule so its final sampled byte is held unchanged throughout `rsp_valid`, including response stalls, and changes only when the next command is accepted or reset occurs. Keep the top annotation `// @latency 33`, and preserve all `HALF_PERIOD` timing, handshake, reset, and bus behavior.
